post.text:
Me pasa mi hija Sara otro vídeo de ella en la feria de Alcasar de 2016. Domando al toro con mucho arte, pero sobretodo, con mucho cariño.

De Cuenca para el mundo, Sara Ruqueza Gavilan, La chica TOP 1 en tendencias de España y Latinoamérica 🇦🇷❤️🇪🇸 https://t.co/wrOyiDHiVt
post.author_description: Empresario, Forbes 30u30 Seleccionador @EnMaroc 🇲🇦 cuenta parodia | Powered by @rainbetcom

description.description: A woman in a red polka-dot flamenco dress performs an artistic routine with a bull in an arena for an audience. In the first frame, she faces away as the bull charges towards her. In the second, she turns to face the bull as it nears her. In the third, she stands with her arms raised as the bull prepares to charge again. In the final frame, the bull stops and she leans in to kiss it on the forehead.
